OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_JACK_SPARROW_: Once per act, right-click to choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]10[/blue] ordinary Relics. Gain it when you reach the marked map node.
It points to what you truly want.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_THE_D6.title: The D6
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_THE_D6.descri: Gain [blue]6[/blue] charges when obtained. Gain [blue]1[/blue] charge after each completed room. At full charge, right-click to reroll an unclaimed Elite or chest Relic reward, or an unpurchased shop Relic.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_YUM_HEART.des: Gain [blue]4[/blue] charges when obtained. Gain [blue]1[/blue] charge after each completed room. At full charge, right-click to heal [blue]6[/blue] HP.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_LIL_BATTERY.d: Right-click to choose an active Relic and fully recharge it. Consumed on use.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_LIL_BATTERY.f: A little charge for the next use.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_DECK_OF_WONDE: At the start of combat, shuffle [blue]5[/blue] [gold]Scrolls of Wonder[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
“挑一张卡吧，哪张都行。等等！不！别动那张！”——之前一个主人的遗言
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_KURAS_DICE.de: At the start of each combat, rolls a random number from 1 to 6. Right-click this relic to activate the ability of the current roll. Each face can only be used once; after using the six, this relic is permanently disabled.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_KURAS_DICE.fl: 恢复，复制，强化，结界，爆炸，实现愿望。发动吧，命运之骰！
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_KURAS_DICE.de: The wish has been granted. Permanently disabled.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_KURAS_DICE.fa: All cards gain [blue]1[/blue] extra [gold]Replay[/gold] for the rest of combat. {Status}
Damage dealt and [gold]Block[/gold] gained are tripled this turn, and gain [blue]3[/blue] Energy. {Status}
Gain [green]8[/green] [gold]Buffer[/gold], [green]8[/green] [gold]Intangible[/gold], and [green]8[/green] [gold]Artifact[/gold] for the rest of combat. {Status}
Deal [blue]300[/blue] damage to each enemy once per player{Status}
Gain [blue]999[/blue] Gold, heal to full, [gold]Upgrade[/gold] every card, gain [blue]6[/blue] relics, and permanently disable this relic. {Status}
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_ASHEN_FLASK.d: Removes one potion slot. Right-click this relic to restore [blue]15%[/blue] of your Max HP. Has [blue]2[/blue] uses; kindling at a campfire refills it and raises the cap by [blue]1[/blue]. Defeating an Elite or a Boss has a [blue]50%[/blue] chance to restore one use.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_ASHEN_FLASK.c: Right-click this relic to restore [blue]15%[/blue] of your Max HP.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_ASHEN_FLASK.f: 自古以来，不死人总是在营火间穿梭，而原素瓶也一直随之旅行。
At the start of combat, gain [green]1[/green] [gold]Buffer[/gold] and [green]1[/green] [gold]Artifact[/gold]. At the start of each turn, heal [green]1[/green] HP; if you are below half your Max HP, heal [green]2[/green] instead.
来自泰拉瑞亚的配饰，在塔里它带给你自然恢复的力量。
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_SPORE_SAC.des:
Once per turn, release all stored [gold]Poison[/gold] against the first enemy that attacks you. Starts at [green]1[/green].
From turn [blue]2[/blue], store [green]2[/green] temporary Poison each turn; releasing clears the temporary charge. Every [blue]3[/blue] victories, permanently gain [green]1[/green] base Poison.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_SPORE_SAC.fla: 来自泰拉瑞亚的配饰，被激怒时会喷出剧毒的孢子云。
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_CROSS_NECKLAC:
When you draw a [gold]Status[/gold] or [gold]Curse[/gold], [gold]Exhaust[/gold] it and draw a card.
At the end of your turn, [gold]Exhaust[/gold] all Statuses and Curses in your hand. Gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold] for each.
来自泰拉瑞亚的配饰，据说能让佩戴者在受创的瞬间获得片刻庇护。
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_SHRINK_RAY.de: Right-click to gain a [gold]Shrink Ray[/gold] card. Unlimited.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_SHRINK_RAY.fl: 哆啦A梦的道具之一。被光照到的东西会缩小，照得越久缩得越小；想变回原样，得用放大灯。
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_AIR_CANNON.de: At the start of combat, add a [blue]1[/blue]-cost [gold]Bonk[/gold] card to your hand.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_AIR_CANNON.fl: 哆啦A梦的道具之一。套在手上，就能像大炮一样打出压缩空气，把人轰飞却不会受伤。
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_MOMOTARO_DUMP: You have [blue]3[/blue] dumplings. Right-click and choose an enemy to tame: normal monsters with less than [green]10[/green] current HP and elites with less than [green]15[/green] current HP can be tamed, and bosses cannot. The tamed enemy dies immediately in the current combat; starting from the next combat it joins you as a pet with its Max HP set to [blue]80%[/blue] of the original for normal monsters and [blue]60%[/blue] for elites, restored to full. It fights for you with its own moves and intents but deals [blue]50%[/blue] less damage, cannot be healed, and disappears forever when it dies.
哆啦A梦的道具之一。桃太郎用来收服同伴的丸子，给动物吃下，它就会对你言听计从。
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_FOUR_DIMENSIO: When obtained, immediately grants a Doraemon gadget. The next [blue]3[/blue] relics you would obtain from Elite combats are replaced by Doraemon gadgets.
哆啦A梦的道具之一。正式名称是「机器人专用四次元空间内藏秘密道具收纳口袋」，连着四次元世界，装再多东西也不会变重。
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_ANYWHERE_DOOR: Right-click to turn on free travel, letting you head straight to any unvisited node. Has [blue]3[/blue] uses; right-click again to turn it off.
Right-click to turn on free travel, letting you head straight to any unvisited node.
哆啦A梦的道具之一。心里想着要去的地方再开门，就能到那里；可它到不了海底，也不能穿越时间。

While free travel is on, every unvisited node on the map lights up as reachable; while it is off, nothing changes. Moving along map paths does not consume a use — only flying straight to a non-adjacent node costs [blue]1[/blue]. On the last remaining use, you cannot pick a route whose destination is a node you have already visited.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_BAMBOO_COPTER: At the start of combat, take off: you take [blue]50%[/blue] less damage from attacks. Expires after you are hit [blue]5[/blue] times.
哆啦A梦的道具之一。内置反重力装置，戴在头上就能飞，靠心里想着方向来操控——只是电池撑不了太久。
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_WHAT_IF_PHONE: Restart this combat on a new timeline.
哆啦A梦的道具之一。对着话筒说出你想要的世界，现实就会变成那样；说完挂上电话，铃声响过之后便会成真。
Changes your card draw order and more.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_TIME_CLOTH.de: Right-click to gain a [gold]Time Cloth[/gold] card. Only once per combat.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_TIME_CLOTH.fl: 哆啦A梦的道具之一。把东西包起来，时间就会前进或后退——旧的变新，新的变旧。
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_DAVES_SEEDS.d: Right-click this relic and pick one of three summon cards to bring a plant into the fight (paying that card's cost). Plants protect you from damage. Once per combat. After summoning, right-click again to gain a [gold]Fertilize[/gold] card.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_DAVES_SEEDS.s: {Cost} Energy, {Hp} HP. While in play, grants you {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_DAVES_SEEDS.p: {Cost} Energy, {Hp} HP. While in play, deals {Damage} damage to the front enemy at the start of each turn.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_DAVES_SEEDS.w: {Cost} Energy, {Hp} HP. While in play, gains {Block} [gold]Block[/gold] at the start of each turn.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_DAVES_SEEDS.f: {Cost} Energy. Your plants gain {Hp} Max HP and heal the same amount.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_OMNITRIX.desc: Right-click to choose from [blue]3[/blue] alien heroes and transform ([blue]2%[/blue] chance to be replaced by [gold]Ghostfreak[/gold]).
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_OMNITRIX.flav: 小小年纪所向无敌，神秘超能力，双手并用变身启动，实在好神奇，捍卫和平维护正义，叫他第一名。Ben 10。
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_FOUR_SOULS_GE: An ancient jewel said to grant its holder's wish and to greatly empower whoever possesses it. Upon being obtained it shatters for unknown reasons into the [gold]Jewel of Four Souls Fragment[/gold], and every non-Boss enemy on the map gains a shard as well.
The priestess Midoriko tore the demon's soul away and cast it out together with her own — all that remained was this crystal of souls. Their battle still rages inside it, without end.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_FOUR_SOULS_FR: Right-click to toggle on or off (cannot be toggled in combat); while on, both you and the enemies gain power from their souls. Enemies holding shards appear on the map; defeating them lets you take those shards.

Wasteland grants enemies Strength, Harmony Plating, Fortune Regen, and Wonder Max HP; the effect is comparable to a Burning Elite from the first game. Each shard is granted to only one enemy, but a single enemy can hold several shards.
After the jewel shattered, its countless shards scattered across the land, each bearing one of the four souls — Wasteland for courage, Harmony for kinship, Fortune for love, and Wonder for wisdom.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_EXCALIBUR.des: When your attack damage is lower than its target's [gold]Block[/gold], increase that hit's damage to the target's [gold]Block[/gold].
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_EXCALIBUR.fla: A promise shines across the lake.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_TRUE_EXCALIBU:
At the start of combat, gain [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
When your attack damage is lower than its target's [gold]Block[/gold], increase it to that Block and deal extra HP damage equal to [blue]50%[/blue] of the original damage.
The light of a promised victory.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_COMBAT_SCOUTE: Enabled by default. Shows estimated combat power for all players and enemies only during combat. Right-click to toggle the display.
Enemies with [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] take [blue]87.5%[/blue] more damage rather than [blue]75%[/blue].
Enemies with [gold]Weak[/gold] deal [blue]47.5%[/blue] less damage rather than [blue]40%[/blue].
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_GOLDEN_PEN_NIB.desc: Every [blue]10th[/blue] Attack you play deals [blue]double[/blue] damage.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_GOLDEN_VAMBRACE.des: The first time you gain [gold]Block[/gold] from a card each combat, gain [blue]double[/blue] the amount.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_GOLDEN_VITRUVIAN_MI: Cards with Minion in their name deal [blue]double[/blue] damage and grant [blue]double[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_GOLDEN_UNSETTLING_L: The first card each combat that applies a [gold]debuff[/gold] to an enemy applies [blue]double[/blue] the amount.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_GOLDEN_MEMBERSHIP_C: All shop prices become [blue]{Discount}%[/blue] of their original price.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_GOLDEN_UNDYING_SIGI: Enemies with at least as much [gold]Doom[/gold] as HP deal [blue]75%[/blue] less attack damage.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_SILVER_PEN_NIB.desc: Every [blue]9th[/blue] Attack you play deals double damage.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_SILVER_FIXED_ENERGY: At the start of your [blue]turn {Turn}[/blue], gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
At the start of your [blue]turn {Turn}[/blue], gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
At the start of your [blue]turn {Turn}[/blue], gain [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] and [blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_ENCHANTING_TA: Experience level: [blue]{Level}[/blue] ({Progress}/{NextLevel}). Defeated enemies grant experience equal to one sixth of their original Max HP. Rest sites grant [blue]15[/blue] experience. Right-click during combat to choose a card and spend [blue]1[/blue] level for a random enchantment. At a rest site, spend [blue]5[/blue] levels to permanently enchant and upgrade a card.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_LIFE_FRUIT.de: At the start of combat, gain [blue]{Absorption}[/blue] [gold]Absorption[/gold].
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_LIFE_FRUIT.fl: Life gathered deep in the jungle.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_VITAL_CRYSTAL: When obtained, permanently increase Max HP by [blue]20%[/blue].
A stronger heartbeat returns from the Shimmer.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_AEGIS_FRUIT.d: At the start of combat, gain [blue]{Metallicize}[/blue] [gold]Metallicize[/gold].
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_PALADIN_SHIEL:
While above [blue]25%[/blue] HP, take [blue]25%[/blue] of the damage other teammates would receive.
At the end of your turn, gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold], plus [blue]{BlockPerTeammate}[/blue] per teammate.
As long as I stand, you will not face this blow alone.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_TERRARIA_CROS: During each attack, take damage only from the [blue]first[/blue] hit that strikes you.
A moment of shelter against a relentless assault.
Whenever you take damage, release [blue]1–3[/blue] [gold]Bees[/gold]. Each deals [blue]3[/blue] damage and applies [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Poison[/gold] to a random enemy.
Sweet protection comes with a sting.
